name: Blockheads

comments.content: OMG this game is insane! Got the Revolver upgrade and BOOM, took down three enemies at once! #BlockheadsFTW

comments.author: Neon_Phoenix_XX_42
comments.content: What even is this game? I thought it was fun but man, that Katana took some getting used to. Still, loving the health upgrades.

comments.content: Is it just me or does anyone else think hitting 'em with a Broadsword is way more satisfying than a Revolver?

comments.content: I'm starting to get the hang of things in Blockheads. Those health boosts really help in those close encounters!

comments.author: Vengeful_Aura87
comments.content: Can't believe how addicting this game is! Had a blast last night getting those speed upgrades and outrunning everyone.

comments.author: Cosmic_Katana_XX
comments.content: Heard about the game from some friends, turns out it's pretty cool. Just started, though, so looking forward to leveling up!

comments.author: NoobSurvivor_42
comments.content: Just started playing and already loving it. The game's so fast-paced, keeps you on your toes all the time. Great fun!

comments.author: Leviathan_Slayer99

comments.author: NeonDefeatXX
comments.content: Not gonna lie, Blockheads is tough. But so rewarding when you finally take someone out. Love the upgrades!

userInputText: Blockheads 是一款块状第一人称射击游戏，您可以在其中与其他在线玩家一起战斗！跳入一场枪战，一次击倒所有人，与对手争夺最终武器！利用游戏中的升级系统来增加您的健康、速度、恢复等，让您比其他玩家更具优势！在这场你死我活的战斗中决一死战，看看你能否成为顶级的傻瓜！
